description: Audit log: one row per node execution in a workflow Journey - node id, type, outcome, detail, duration. Written in the interpreter's transaction and committed at the suspension boundary with everything else. Retention by age.

fields.label: Journey
fields.description: The Journey this step belongs to.

fields.label: Subject Name
fields.description: The subject record the Journey is about - denormalised for quick filtering.

fields.label: Node Type
fields.description: The node's type - Step, Branch, Assign, Wait, or Terminal.

fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: What happened at this node. For a node that runs a verb this is the verb's own DECLARED output - sent, failed, succeeded, assigned, nobody - so the audit says whether the thing actually happened. For a control node it is ok, parked, resumed, done, or failed.

fields.label: Detail
fields.description: Human-readable detail of the outcome, e.g. the branch taken or a failure message.

name: CRM Workflow Step Log
